title: cochlearia groenlandica subsp. islandica
intro: Cochlearia groenlandica subsp. islandica, commonly known as Arctic rockcress or island rockcress, is a subspecies of flowering plant that belongs to the mustard family (Brassicaceae). It is traditionally used in folk medicine due to its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, potentially helping to alleviate symptoms of arthritis, digestive issues, and even certain types of cancer. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include isothiocyanates, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, that exhibit antimicrobial, antiviral, and anti-cancer activities. The bioactive constituents of Cochlearia groenlandica subsp. islandica also have the potential to protect against oxidative stress, inflammation, and cell damage.
